idea: baby catches daddy eating her cookies
title: Daddy's Cookie Crime
description: She caught me red-handed... and negotiated like a pro. Daddy's cookie crime is safe, for now.

scenes.image_prompt: Cozy kitchen at night under a warm lamp. The dad is frozen mid-bite with a cookie in his mouth and his hand inside a pink cookie jar, eyes wide and guilty. Beside him the little girl stands holding a teddy bear, pointing up at him with a shocked open mouth. Medium shot.
scenes.action: slow push in on the dad's guilty face

scenes.image_prompt: Cozy kitchen at night. The dad crouches down to the little girl's height with cookie crumbs on his chin, holding a finger to his lips with an awkward smile. The little girl has her arms crossed and her chin up, squinting at him suspiciously. Close two-shot.

dialogue.speaker: lily
dialogue.line: Hmph! I tell Mommy on you!

scenes.image_prompt: Cozy kitchen at night with golden bokeh. The little girl happily hugs the dad's neck while holding a half-eaten cookie, giggling with eyes squeezed shut. The dad melts with a huge happy smile. Close-up, heartwarming.
